<function name="WriteUInt64" parent="File" type="classfunc">
	<description>Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer to the file.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2023.08.30</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="uint64" type="string">The unsigned 64-bit integer to be written to the file.

<note>Since Lua cannot store full 64-bit integers, this function takes a string. It is mainly aimed at usage with <page>Player:SteamID64</page>.</note>
</arg>
	</args>
</function>
